name: Club for Growth
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5; Weight 3 lbs.; Price 13,300 gp

DESCRIPTION

This club appears to be a typical +1 club decorated with cryptic “greater than” and “less than” symbols. When it lands a critical hit the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 14) or be affected by a reduce person spell for 5 minutes. If the target fails, the wielder is simultaneously affected by an enlarge person spell for the same time. Once per day a club for growth can also be used to cast plant growth as a 5th level caster. Additionally, this club imparts a +4 enhancement bonus to all Appraise checks the wielder makes.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Heighten Spell, Spells enlarge person, reduce person, plant growth; Cost 6,650 gp
